criteria.requirement: ‘Sjekk selskapet gratis’ is the single primary public action and starts the canonical free provisional eligibility flow.

Provisional/definitive eligibility, NOK 1,490 including VAT, three filings, supported/blocked/clarify boundary, refund, operator, and non-affiliation copy exactly match the owner-approved versioned sources.

Recruitment mode cannot claim or enable paid production; live claims and checkout require the exact capability version, immutable release state, runtime switches, and a definitive eligibility continuation.

Marketing measurement accepts no personal, company, financial, bank, filing, document, or free-text data; non-essential collection starts only after explicit consent and uses a short-lived anonymous first-party session.

Every required funnel event and bounded reason code can be recorded through a first-party provider-neutral endpoint and reported as aggregate conversion, timing, error/help, refund/unsupported, and completion metrics without cross-site identifiers.

Homepage, scope, price, help, terms, privacy, security, and status are indexable with Norwegian metadata, canonical HTTPS URLs, sitemap, robots, social preview, favicon, semantic headings, and truthful Organization/SoftwareApplication structured data.
Rendered public and signup/checkout-shell journeys pass copy, keyboard, focus, labels/status, contrast, 200% zoom/reflow, 390px mobile, performance, and no-horizontal-overflow gates.

Ad and checkout stop rules fail closed whenever eligibility, capability, production, billing, bank, filing, security, UX, deadline, data-integrity, charge, or support-capacity evidence is red or stale.
